identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: one after another, or concurrently?
identity.brief_workload: Supplied fixed-work dhfr_ensemble.py driver using the published PME model
identity.publication_status: Upstream model, executable code, command and inputs are public. The fixed-work wrapper is supplied in the brief; no independent publication of its performance was identified.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize total wall seconds for 8 independent 25000-step replicas on one GPU.
outcome_definition.speedup: Sequential total_wall_s divided by candidate ensemble total_wall_s on the same GPU.
outcome_definition.scientific_outputs: Per-replica final and mean potential energy in kJ/mol, using 100 samples spaced 250 steps apart.

citations.role: Ensemble driver, fixed work, seeds, install and run commands; predictions are not measurements.
Public executable PME benchmark and molecular model.
Independent published fixed-time throughput observations; not fixed-work ensemble results.

components.licence: NVIDIA component terms; exact terms not independently inspected in this intake.

source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.redistribution_permission_reason: Not required for intended local use; no blanket redistribution permission inferred.

stock_cuda_image.feasibility: Provisionally plausible, pending stock-image and driver inspection and reproduction.
evidence: OpenMM 8.2.0 publishes CPython 3.10 through 3.13 manylinux x86_64 wheels targeting glibc 2.27/2.28.
OpenMM-CUDA-12 8.2.0 publishes a manylinux x86_64 plugin wheel and declares NVIDIA CUDA runtime, nvcc, nvrtc, cupti and cufft dependencies.
Brief requires a CUDA-12-capable NVIDIA driver and one data-centre GPU.
unknowns: Stock image identity, architecture, Python, glibc and GPU driver were not supplied or inspected.
MPS daemon availability and container permissions unverified.
CUDA execution and deterministic trajectories unverified.

resources.data_scope: Pinned PDB plus two force-field XML source files only; does not include software or dependencies.
resources.reason: No published peak host/device working-set measurement for this ensemble, especially 8 concurrent contexts; no workload run.

scoring.reason: NVIDIA performance observation is a reference, not an acceptance criterion for this workload. Brief speedup ranges are hypotheses.
scoring.scientific_acceptance: Brief predicts identical same-seed energy series; failing bit identity, it proposes comparison against same-seed baseline run-to-run variation. No numeric energy acceptance tolerance or variation estimate is supplied.
scoring.reference_scoring: No pass/fail score from null-tolerance references.

repeatability_rules.seed_use: Same replica seed for initial velocities and integrator random stream.
controls: Same GPU model and GPU count 1
Same seeds in sequential and concurrent runs
repeatability_rules.repeat_count_reason: Brief supplies no mandatory count or statistical aggregation protocol.
repeatability_rules.determinism_caveat: DeterministicForces documents force reproducibility; single-precision PME trajectory determinism must be checked. General platform documentation cautions that single-precision CUDA PME is not universally deterministic.

search_note: No benchmark search or substitution. Only brief-named primary sources fetched.
limitations: No absolute sequential H100 throughput published for this exact fixed-work configuration.
Source benchmark.py adapts integration steps for fixed-time throughput; supplied fixed-work driver avoids this scale adaptation.
